Purple Dragon Foundation

Purple Dragon AI Agent

A local-first Windows AI workspace with permission-controlled tools and LM Studio integration.

Public source · v2.0.0
View sourceRepositoryGet help

What it does

  • Workspace files, code proposals, snapshots, and approved tests
  • Project memory and domain-controlled research
  • Reviewed Git actions and coordinated specialist tasks

Requirements

Windows, Python 3.10+ and Microsoft Edge WebView2. Python 3.12 or 3.13 is recommended. LM Studio is optional.

Getting started

Extract into a new folder and run Run-PurpleDragonAI.bat. First setup requires internet. Keep SAFE MODE and review tool approvals. Public source does not imply a packaged executable is available.

Release notes, integrity & license

Read the current project documentation before installing. Where a release supplies checksums or signed manifests, use the instructions for that exact package. Check the repository’s license and third-party notices before reusing code or assets.

Project information reviewed November 12, 2026. For new versions, follow the repository’s release notes.
